speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your specific symptoms regarding the gait and limb ataxia, and list any significant medical conditions or past surgeries in your history. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Vitamin_B12_Level.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

The combination of uncontrolled Crohn's disease, recent initiation of natalizumab, and new onset gait/limb ataxia is highly specific for PML, a rare but serious opportunistic infection of the central nervous system. I am requesting MRI images of your brain immediately to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of white matter lesions.
